headline: India's manufacturing activity moderates in June amid weaker demand: PMI - OrissaPOST
summary: India's HSBC Manufacturing PMI fell to 54.2 in June from 55.0 in May, as new business orders and international sales rose at softer rates. Employment and output expansion also slowed.
why: The PMI is a monthly survey of purchasing managers that serves as an early read on industrial activity, which investors use to gauge economic momentum in India.
